title: Allahu Hasbi
body:
I pray 2 raqats, may our assembly be holy. May my Lord and His beloved be pleased with us.
May the awliya help us, Allahu Akbar. Fatiha.
Assalamu Alaikum. Oh the lovers of Shah Mardan. Oh the friends. Who are friends? The ones,
who follow the way of Shah Mardan, who serve and love him. are his friends. Assalamu Alaikum
oh friends of Shah Mardan. Let's send salam. Salam brings peace. And let's say Bismillahi rRahmanir- Rahim. Allah Dhul Jalal Hazrat the owner of Majesty granted the nation of His
beloved, opens the doors of heavens & earth, dresses people with the dress of humanity, that
gives people honor, that dresses people with the attribute of being a friend of Shah Mardan.
When we say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim heavens & earth shake.
Listen! Oh friends of Shah Mardan. How beautiful, how nice! I stand up to mention our Lord's
name Jalla wa Ala. I stand up. Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim I say. How wonderful it is to say
Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. What a great honor. Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar
Wa Lillahil Hamd. Sayfu r-Rahman, Sahib Maydan. Shah Mardan Be honorable. Lion of our
Master, Lion of the arenas Ali Ibn Abu Talib, Shah Mardan, martyr for your way. Come on in.
Marhaba to you ikhwan, who listen, friends, lovers. How many friends does he have? Whoever
says Bismillahir - Rahmani r-Rahim is his friend Who, doesn't say Basmala is a friend of
animals. Whoever says Basmala they are friends of Shah Mardan.
Oh those who make meaningless claims. Who say I'm alawi, I'm shia! Which way of Allah's Lion
do you follow? Whoever draws a sword to kill someone should know that a zabani angel stands
on top of his head with a sword in his hand; he will hit. That angel will cut his head. He should
know this. To the innocent people, Allahu Dhul Jalal honored them, made them honorable. He
said to angels, prostrate to Adam. How do you show respect to the son of Adam? Janab-i

Wajibul Wujud Allahu Dhul Jalal. What He said to angels; "usjudu li'adam" prostrate to Adam.
Allahu Akbar. Oh Shah Mardan how nice he speaks. You despicable man! You, the dogs of the
devil! How can you kill, hit, cut into pieces a human being? Allahu Dhul Jalal wanted angels to
prostrate to mankind. then you say; we are Alawi, we are Shia. It's a lie. An angel upon you,
with a sword in his hand waiting. He will cut your head.
Beware! This is not just for Shia or Alawi. This is for all oppressors. "Wa la tazalamu" I'm not an
oppressor says Janabul Haqq. I forbid Myself oppression, and also you. I order you not to
oppress. Don't even step on an ant to kill it. Because Janabul Haqq made him speak also. Look.
The great Prophet Sulaiman, Ala Nabina Alayhi Salatu was Salam, When coming with his army
"qalat namlatun" (27:18) An order came to the ant, to the leader ant of the ants with that
inspiration. What did the ant say? "ya ayyuha an-namlu udkhulu masakinakum" (27:18) Oh
ants get into your homes. "la yahtimannakum Sulaymanu wajunuduhu" (27:18) So that he won't
step, crush you, Sulaiman and his soldiers. Sayyidina Suleiman, who rules over humans and
jinns, what is the order for him? Take care of Allah's creation. You also don't stand in the way of
him. Sulaiman, the owner of the Sultanate is coming. Janabu Mawla crowned him with
Prophecy. Sayyidina Sulaiman, who has a mandate to rule from east to west, is coming with his
army, stay out of his way. Stay out of his way because he is coming with his army. He'll step on
you.
Subhan Allah. Oh the one with a brain, Listen to Shah Mardan. Janabu Allah orders his
Prophet. Prophet Sulaiman was at war by the Order of Allah. He would pass through that
place. Who created the ant? Allahu Dhul Jalal created it. An order was given to the leader of the
ants. "ya ayyuha n-namlu udkhulu masakinakum" (27:18) Oh the ants run back to your homes.
"la yahtimannakum sulaymanu wa junuduhu wahum la yasha'uruna" (27:18) Because Allah
dressed Prophet Sulaiman with majesty and dominion. A reign like his wasn't given to anyone
else from humans or jinn. Prophet Sulaiman ruled over humans and jinn. Oh honorable
Prophet. Honorable Prophet, Sayyidina Sulaiman, with his greatness he also stood in the
presence of the Prophet of the end of times, with good manners, Prophet Sulaiman. Allahu
Akbar. When Prophet Sulaiman received the news of our Master; when Wazir Asaf, who had
been given knowledge from the book gave him the news, Prophet Sulaiman trembled, with all
his majesty.

Our master is the Master of the Universe. He is the Prophet of the End of Times. The pride of
the Universe, beloved of Janabul Haqq. No one can reach his station. "Come my beloved." No
one was addressed like this but our Master. Prophet Jesus, Prophet Moses, Prophet Sulaiman,
hundreds thousands of Prophets revered by Him. On the night of Ascension. when he
descended to Bayt-ul Maqdus 124.000 Prophets stood in rows. Oh Glorious Rasul, Oh Glorious
Rasul, intercede for us, it is in your power. We lost our way. The devil messed things up, to
take the honor from the sons of Adam. The devil's angry because he envied that honor given to
mankind. It must be given to me, said he. Rebel.
You have that degree of honor oh son of Adam. Did Janabul Haqq say "Kill each other"? Is it
written in Bible, Old Testament or The Book of Psalms to kill each other? If not, draw your
sword, cut the devils. Destroy the ones with the devil's attributes. Keep the sword of majesty,
that sword is given to you by the hand of the Prophet of end of times; to all Prophets. He didn't
give it to Jesus, Ala Nabi'ina Alayhi Salatu was Salam. Prophet Jesus was allowed to say
Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. They attacked him, wanted to hang him. They wanted to cut
him. The sword of Bismillahi r-Rahmani r- Rahim was granted to Jesus (as) once. He held the
sword in his hand once. Which sword? Sword of Bismillahi r- Rahmanir-Rahim. Say it and
come to me.
Marrafa'ahullah "wa ma qataluhu wa ma salabuhu walakin shubbiha lahum" (4:157) Janabul
Mawla said about Jesus (as) that they neither killed him or crucified him. It's a lie.
Marrafa'ahullah Ilayh. Maybe Allah raised Jesus(as) to the heavens. We believe this. You believe
in nonsense. How ridiculous? You crucify Jesus(as). You show everyone a naked man on a cross.
What kind of religion is this? Would Janabul Haqq let them disgrace a prophet? Allahu Dhul
Jalal, Whose Majesty is limitless, would He disgrace His Prophet? They say Jesus (as) is more
than a Prophet. Allah forbid. They say he is the son of Allah. If he is the son of Allah, how is it
that Allah doesn't protect His son? He lets three and a half unbelievers hold him, nail him to the
cross? Then you come and cry. This is your superficial belief.
If he couldn't save himself, how can he save others? Think, O nation of the book, the nation of
the Bible. How can it be oh believers of the Bible? What is this? He couldn't save himself. If he
couldn't save himself, how can he save others? He said; "say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r- Rahim oh

my servant Jesus. Say Basmala, I shall take you to heavens. You may sit in your station. We,
Muslims believe in this. We don't accept a Prophet who's crucified. It's fake. Incorrect. Allah
Allah. Allah is Powerful. And you say he is the son, then you crucify him on the cross. What is
this? How ridiculous? That's the way we believe it. We invented all these weapons to finish off
Muslims. This will finish off Muslims, If 100 times more non-muslim soldiers come, they can't
finish off the muslims. Muslim's sword is up like this, sword of Shah Mardan, it's up. Islam and
Muslims won't be made low, the servants of Allah Jalil. We are lions.
Say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Come to the right way O those, who have forgotten their
humanity, who think ignorance is their job. Come to the right way. Don't insist on falsehood.
Don't think that these bombs, weapons can finish off Islam. Cannot. Cannot. They may finish
you off but not Islam because no power can defeat "Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim, Allahu
Akbar Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar" - when a muslim says this. Pull yourselves together. Ignorant
Muslims of this age are scared of them. Alas, if their bombs reach us. If Allah doesn't protect
you their bombs, arms, whatever they call it, missiles, they can not protect you. It falls on your
head. What is going to protect you is Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim.
Say oh Muslim. Listen to Shah Mardan. Say Bismillahi r-Rahmanir-Rahim. Be under his
protection. Don't worry. Nothing will happen to you. They are needy for weapons. We aren't.
Muslims lost themselves. You have the sword of... Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. When Shah
Mardan has Dhul Fiqqar; when there are the banners of La ilaha ill'Allah Muhammadur
Rasulullah, we won't be defeated, the banner won't fall . 7 heavens will be overwhelmed. La
ilaha ill'Allah Muhammadur Rasulullah, the noble banner, won't fall down. The world will be
upside down, will explode. Pull yourself together. Oh Iranians, Alawis, Shias! We built a weapon
factory. Hope it explodes on your head. We have this many planes. It crushes you. Won't touch
muslims. Let's say Shah Mardan, Owner of the Arenas, the Lion of Allah, send us help - The
power to give a lesson to those who don't know their limits. Shah Mardan; say Bismillahi rRahmani r-Rahim and don't fear. We don't fear China, USA or Europe.
Once upon a time a holy person said when arguing with the People of the Book, We're right,
you're right. Our power is spiritual he said. Ok he said come here. There's a bent tower in Italy
that stays bowed and bends more. He told him come here, let's make a test. If you straighten

this tower, we will follow you. If you can't straighten it listen to us. Come, if your religion is
Truth, straighten this tower. The Pope or the leader said don't come closer. The Muslims can
straighten it, and our religion sinks. That's why that tower is left that way, bent. Islam is as
straight as a line.
Shah Mardan's Dhul Fiqqar waits like this on the backs of their necks. Today is Wednesday.
Wednesday is a heavy day. May the weight of this day be lifted. Let's say at least 7 times, Shah
Mardan says: Salamun Qawlan min Rabbir Rahim desin. (36:58) Don't fear. If the sky is full of
their planes, don't fear. Say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim 7 times, nothing will touch you. If
you are among lions, they can't turn around and look at you. Oh Muslims, oh Shah Mardan.
We sacrifice for your way, Oh Shah Mardan send us help. May your support reach us. He is
that way. Shah Mardan answers: He gave you the Basmala Sharif. It is greater than the power I
have. I also take from that Power. You'll also be given power. Say Basmala or you'll be swept
away. Don't look at their great numbers. They can't send the bombs, etc., cannot touch Islam.
Banner of Islam is Lailaha ill'Allah Muhammadur Rasulullah Allahumma sabbitna ala l-haqq.
Our Lord keep us on the right path.
The non muslim world doesn't know the majesty of Islam. Islam world is confused too. They see
non muslims as superior. They believe in the useless machines in their hands. They say these will
protect us. They won't! Be a Muslim.! Say Bismillahi r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Oh Shah Mardan
help us. Glorious Shah Mardan send us your support. Your one call shakes the world, Shah
Mardan. We're weak. We grow weaker. But in fact no one is stronger than we.
Oh our Lord forgive us. Oh glorious Prophet intercede for us. Oh Shah Mardan accept us to
be under your Dhul Fiqqar and your banner. Amin amin amin. Give our bodies good health.
May the dress of majesty and good health be dressed on us. Bi hurmatil Baytil Atiq, for the
honor of The Ancient House. Amin amin. Wa salamun ala l-mursalin. Hususan ala Sayyidil
Mursalin. Oh Shah Mardan Masha'Allah. Our hearts are filled with happiness. There's nobody
who can reject our words, either in the east or the west.
Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Rabbi Allahu Allah Allahu Hasbi Allahu Allah
Allahu Allah Allahu Allah Allahu Rabbi Allahu Allah Allahu Hasbi. Allah. Say this, don't fear.
Masha'Allah.
Don't ring the bells. Say this. Don't run in the streets. Oh Muslims, say this. Say Allahu Allah

Allahu Rabbi Allahu Allah Allahu Hasbi. Don't fear.
Fatiha.
